tools.name: get_todo
tools.description: Your Canvas to-do list: assignments and discussions Canvas says still need attention, with due dates. Example: "What does Canvas say I still need to do?"

tools.name: get_upcoming_due_dates
tools.description: Upcoming assignments and events across every Canvas course, soonest first. Example: "What is due in Canvas this week?"

tools.name: get_missing_assignments
tools.description: Past-due Canvas assignments you have not submitted, with the course and the day each was due. Example: "What am I missing in Canvas?"

tools.name: get_assignments
tools.description: Assignments for one Canvas course. Pass course_id (ask get_my_courses for it) and get due dates, points and submission status: not submitted, submitted, graded, missing or excused. Set bucket to filter, for example overdue. Example: "Which Canvas assignments in Networking 1 are overdue?"

tools.name: get_my_grades
tools.description: Your current grade in each active Canvas course from the Canvas gradebook, with the assignments behind each grade: your score, the points possible and the submission status. Pass course_id (ask get_my_courses for it) for one course only. Example: "What is my grade in each Canvas course and which assignments make it up?"

tools.name: get_course_content
tools.description: Modules and module items for one Canvas course. Pass course_id (ask get_my_courses for it). Example: "Show me the Week 3 module in my Canvas Networking course."

tools.name: get_syllabus
tools.description: The syllabus text for one Canvas course, with HTML removed. Pass course_id (ask get_my_courses for it). Example: "What does the Canvas syllabus say about grading in Scripting?"

tools.name: get_announcements
tools.description: Recent Canvas announcements, either for the course_ids you pass or for all your active courses. Example: "What did my instructors announce in Canvas lately?"

tools.name: get_whats_new
tools.description: One catch up across your Canvas courses: announcements posted in the last few days, assignments graded in that window and discussions that still have unread replies. Pass since_days to change the window, 7 by default, or course_id (ask get_my_courses for it) to check one course. Example: "What's new in Canvas since last week?"

tools.name: get_discussions
tools.description: Discussion topics for one Canvas course, with unread counts. Pass course_id (ask get_my_courses for it). Example: "What discussions are open in my Canvas Networking course?"

tools.name: get_calendar_events
tools.description: Canvas calendar events and assignment due dates. Pass start_date and end_date as YYYY-MM-DD to limit the range. Example: "What is on my Canvas calendar between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-31?"
